info.title: joinedcontext Portal API
info.description: Administrative and platform management REST API for joinedcontext Portal

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/auth/logout` — clears the session and tells the SPA where to send the browser.
post.description:
It answers with JSON rather than a 302 on purpose: the SPA calls this with `fetch`, and a
cross-origin redirect to Keycloak is unreadable to it. The browser navigation is the caller's.

requestBody.description: Optional approval confirmation for red-lane changes

400.description: Bad request or missing red-lane confirmation

503.description: No runner configured, or it did not answer

requestBody.description: RFC 7386 merge patch, as JSON or as the YAML apply-patch document

200.description: Status of the background Git mirror synchronization

204.description: Webhook accepted with no action needed

ApproveBody.description: Request body for approving or rejecting a change proposal.

Change.description: The `Change` resource describing a proposed configuration update.

ChangeAuthor.description: Human author attributed on the change proposal.

name.description:
Identifier formatted as `chg-` plus eight lowercase hex characters derived
from the merge request.

ChangeProposal.description: A change proposal representing an open Git merge request.

ChangeStatus.description: Approval and reconciliation status of a change.

ChangeSummary.description: Human-readable proposal summary parameters derived from the plan diff.

DryRunResult.description: Reviewer-facing validation and diff result returned on `?dryRun=All` (MF-13, R17).

FieldChange.description:
A single leaf field modification in a plan diff.

Paths are dotted strings rooted at `metadata` or `spec` (e.g. `spec.audience`,
`spec.representations[1]`, `metadata.labels.joinedcontext.com/domain`).
Keys containing dots (such as reverse-DNS label names) are deliberately not escaped.

Identity.description: Who is signed in. Returned by `GET /api/v1/auth/me` and used by every protected route.

roles.description:
Keycloak realm roles from the ID token's `realm_access.roles` (CC-42). Empty when the
token asserts none. Display and enablement only — the resource API and the forge enforce
the same boundaries independently.

subject.description: Keycloak `sub`: stable, opaque, the only durable user key.

LogoutTarget.description: The URL the browser must visit to finish an RP-initiated logout at Keycloak.

endSessionUrl.description:
Absolute URL: Keycloak's `end_session_endpoint`, or the portal itself when no realm is
configured.

ObjectMeta.title: ObjectMeta
ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

received.description:
Cumulative since the runner started, exactly as it reports them: a rate is the view's
job, history is Prometheus' job (OPS-16). An absent field is not zero, it is a counter
this runner does not export.

scrapedAt.description: When the Portal read the runner, RFC 3339. The counters are as old as this instant.

PlanDiff.description: Summary and field-level changes between two resource revisions.

oneOf.description: Never read from Git, always computed by the Portal API (MF-04).

Status.description:
The status the Portal API reports (MF-04). It is `jc_core::Status` plus `sourceUrl` and a phase
that is always known; it stays a Portal type until jc-core carries `sourceUrl` too (docs API/01
section 6 is the contract), then it becomes a re-export like its neighbours.

sourceUrl.description:
Forge page of the file this manifest was read from, so a view can link "Source"
without knowing where a kind lives in the repository. Computed, never read from Git.

SyncStatus.description:
Status of the background Git mirror synchronization.

Served to the browser, so it deliberately never carries a token,
repository URL, or branch name.
